items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Sponsored Agents and AI tools for ChatGPT ads
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it is introducing AI-powered ad experiences, including a test of Sponsored Agents that let users start a labeled conversation with a business-sponsored agent after clicking a ChatGPT ad. It also rolled out prompt-based campaign creation in ChatGPT Work, AI creative tools in Ads Manager, and integrations with HubSpot and Shopify.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布推出AI廣告體驗，測試Sponsored Agents：使用者點擊ChatGPT廣告後，可與標示為商家贊助的代理開始對話。同時在ChatGPT Work以提示詞建立廣告活動、強化Ads Manager創作工具，並接上HubSpot與Shopify。
items_flat.analysis_en: This productizes ChatGPT as a discovery and conversion surface, not a new model. Whether Sponsored Agents stay clearly separated from independent answers will determine whether the ads push erodes trust.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是把ChatGPT做成發現與轉換介面，而非新模型。Sponsored Agents能否與獨立回答清楚區隔，將決定廣告擴張會不會侵蝕信任。
items_flat.quote: We’re testing Sponsored Agents, which let people start a conversation with a business-sponsored agent after clicking an ad in ChatGPT.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在測試Sponsored Agents，讓人們點擊ChatGPT裡的廣告後，與商家贊助的代理開始對話。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes misalignment reporting framework and six incident reports
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI公布模型錯位揭露框架並釋出六份事件報告
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published a framework for tracking, investigating and disclosing model misalignment, including cases it has not fully explained or mitigated, and released six reports on unexpected behavior seen in training or evaluation over the last six months. It said there is no industry-wide disclosure standard yet and that it will refine the process with public feedback.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI公布追蹤、調查與公開模型錯位的框架，即使尚未完全解釋或緩解也可揭露，並發布過去六個月訓練或評估中觀察到的六份異常行為報告。公司稱業界尚無統一揭露標準，將依公開回饋調整流程。
items_flat.analysis_en: Timed disclosure of unmitigated cases is more useful than waiting for system cards, but the framework is still self-administered. Whether other labs adopt comparable timelines and third-party access will decide if this becomes a standard or a one-lab practice.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 不等系統卡、先公開未完全緩解的案例，比事後彙整更有資訊價值，但標準仍由實驗室自管。其他大廠是否跟進時程與第三方檢視，才會決定這是行業標準還是單方實踐。
items_flat.quote: We're sharing our new framework for tracking, investigating, and disclosing instances of model misalignment at OpenAI.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正公開OpenAI追蹤、調查並揭露模型錯位案例的新框架。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic merges Claude Chat and Cowork into one assistant
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic將Claude對話與Cowork合併為單一助理
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic said Claude Cowork and chat are merging into one Claude so users no longer pick a mode: the assistant decides whether a request is a quick answer or a longer task, including work that continues after the laptop is closed. It also launched Claude Docs and Claude Slides in beta and brought Claude Design into conversations, rolling out first to Pro and Max.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic宣布Cowork與對話合併為同一個Claude，使用者不必選模式，由助理判斷是快速回答或長任務，關筆電後也可繼續。同步推出Claude Docs與Claude Slides測試版，並把Claude Design放進對話，先對Pro與Max開放。
items_flat.analysis_en: Folding agentic Cowork into every conversation is a product bet that routing should be the model’s job. Enterprise lag and how well Claude chooses task versus chat will decide whether the merge reduces friction or hides failures.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 把代理式Cowork塞進每次對話，等於押注路由該由模型自己做。企業版延遲、以及Claude能否分清長任務與閒聊，會決定這是減摩擦還是把失敗藏起來。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, Claude Cowork and chat are merging into one Claude.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起，Claude Cowork與對話合併為同一個Claude。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic and Novo partner to use Claude in drug discovery
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic與Novo合作將Claude用於藥物發現
items_flat.summary_en: Novo and Anthropic announced on 16 September 2026 that Novo will use Anthropic models and Claude Science on R&D scientific reasoning and agentic software engineering. The companies said they will jointly tackle identified discovery problems and keep human oversight and data governance in place.
items_flat.summary_zh: Novo與Anthropic於2026年9月16日宣布，Novo將把Anthropic模型與Claude Science用於研發科學推理與代理式軟體工程。雙方表示將共同處理已盤點的發現難題，並維持人為監督與資料治理。
items_flat.analysis_en: This moves Claude from Novo’s earlier documentation use case into discovery science itself. Impact still depends on which workflows Claude Science is allowed to touch and how tightly results are validated in the lab.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這讓Claude從Novo先前的文件場景進入發現科學本身。影響仍取決於Claude Science被允許碰哪些流程，以及實驗室驗證有多嚴。
items_flat.quote: By giving leading researchers access to safe, capable, and trusted frontier models, we can shorten research timelines, improve outcomes, and discover medicines and treatments that significantly improve human life.
items_flat.quote_zh: 讓一線研究者使用安全、有能力且可信的前沿模型，我們就能縮短研究時程、改善結果，並發現能顯著改善人類生活的藥物與療法。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI confirms talks with Anthropic and Google on an AI safety standards body
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI證實與Anthropic、Google討論AI安全標準機構
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it has been discussing industry-led AI safety coordination with Anthropic and Google DeepMind, following Demis Hassabis’s earlier idea of a FINRA-like standards body. OpenAI global policy chief Chris Lehane told reporters the talks are exploratory rather than a finished charter.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI表示已與Anthropic、Google DeepMind討論由產業主導的AI安全協調，呼應Hassabis稍早提出類似FINRA的標準機構構想。OpenAI全球政策主管Chris Lehane向媒體說明，目前仍屬探討、尚無章程。
items_flat.analysis_en: A joint evaluator or pre-release test regime would be material if it gets binding access and publish rights. So far this is confirmed talk, not a charter, and antitrust plus smaller-lab exclusion remain open risks.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若聯合評估或發布前測試取得具約束力的存取與公開權，才有實質意義。目前只是證實在談、不是章程，反壟斷與排除較小實驗室仍是風險。
items_flat.quote: It’s better to try to work together to prioritize safety.
items_flat.quote_zh: 最好試著合作，把安全放在優先位置。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA, Google and Emerald AI launch grid-flexible data-centre alliance
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA、Google與Emerald AI成立電網彈性資料中心聯盟
items_flat.summary_en: Emerald AI, Google and NVIDIA announced the AI Energy Management Alliance to push data centres that can cut or shift power draw when the grid is stressed, arguing flexibility should speed interconnection. Eighteen launch partners include Anthropic, Analog Devices, National Grid, AES, RWE, Constellation and NRG.
items_flat.summary_zh: Emerald AI、Google與NVIDIA宣布成立AI能源管理聯盟，推動資料中心在電網吃緊時降載或轉移用電，並主張彈性應換取更快併網。18家啟動夥伴包含Anthropic、Analog Devices、National Grid、AES、RWE、Constellation與NRG。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an interconnection-and-policy play, not a model release. Whether utilities treat flexibility as verifiable capacity will decide if AI campuses connect faster or the alliance stays a talking shop.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是併網與政策布局，不是模型發布。公用事業是否把可驗證的彈性當成容量，將決定AI園區能否更快上電，或聯盟停留在倡議。
items_flat.quote: Today, Emerald AI, Google and NVIDIA announced the launch of the AI Energy Management Alliance (AEMA), a first-of-its-kind coalition advancing data centers that can dynamically manage their electricity use in response to grid conditions.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日Emerald AI、Google與NVIDIA宣布成立AI能源管理聯盟（AEMA），推動能依電網狀態動態管理用電的資料中心。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind launches the DeepMind Institute for AGI debate
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind launched the DeepMind Institute as a platform for essays and debate on AGI’s technical and societal questions, directed by Shane Legg, James Manyika and Demis Hassabis, with Legg as managing editor. The site opened with pieces on economic policy, reasoning transparency, access and human flourishing.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind成立DeepMind Institute，作為AGI技術與社會問題的論文與辯論平台，由Shane Legg、James Manyika與Demis Hassabis主導，Legg任總編。開站文章涵蓋經濟政策、推理透明度、近用與人類繁榮。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a publishing and convening vehicle, not a model or safety evaluator. Its value turns on whether outside authors can disagree in public and whether the essays feed product or policy choices.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是出版與召集機制，不是模型或安全評估器。價值取決於外部作者能否公開唱反調，以及文章會不會進入產品或政策選擇。
items_flat.quote: The institute was created because broad-based intellectual discussion and debate are required to arrive at a consensus about how to address the challenges and opportunities we face as a society.
items_flat.quote_zh: 成立該研究所，是因為要對社會面臨的挑戰與機會形成共識，需要廣泛的智識討論與辯論。

items_flat.title_en: Google opens Home MCP so third-party agents can control Nest devices
items_flat.title_zh: Google開放Home MCP讓第三方代理控制Nest裝置
items_flat.summary_en: Google began early access to a Google Home MCP server so MCP-capable agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, Hermes, OpenClaw and Google Antigravity can inspect structures, read event history and control devices in the Home ecosystem, including Nest. Access is gated through Google Home Premium Advanced and a Cloud project setup.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google開始提供Google Home MCP伺服器早期存取，讓Claude、ChatGPT、Hermes、OpenClaw與Google Antigravity等支援MCP的代理可檢視住家結構、讀事件紀錄並控制含Nest在內的Home裝置。需Google Home Premium Advanced與Cloud專案設定。
items_flat.analysis_en: Opening locks, cameras and HVAC to arbitrary agents is a real capability jump and a concentrated security surface. The paid gate and Cloud-project setup will keep the first wave small.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 把鎖、攝影機與空調交給任意代理，能力躍進同時也是集中資安面。付費門檻與Cloud專案設定會讓第一波規模維持很小。
items_flat.quote: This allows any AI agents that support MCP, including Google Antigravity, Claude, Hermes or Open Claw, to securely work with all of the devices and event history in your Google Home ecosystem.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這讓任何支援MCP的AI代理人，包括Google Antigravity、Claude、Hermes或OpenClaw，能安全地使用Google Home生態系中的裝置與事件紀錄。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic signs agreement for first Australian data centre in Queensland
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic簽署澳洲首座資料中心協議，地點在昆士蘭
items_flat.summary_en: Queensland Premier David Crisafulli said Anthropic signed an agreement for its first Australian data centre at the planned Western Downs Digital Park near Dalby, part of a Zerra DC project. Reuters reported a lease covering a planned 2.16 GW campus slated to start coming online in 2027, subject to FIRB approval, and intended for inference rather than training.
items_flat.summary_zh: 昆士蘭州長Crisafulli表示，Anthropic已為位於Dalby附近Western Downs Digital Park的澳洲首座資料中心簽約，屬Zerra DC計畫。路透稱租約涵蓋規劃2.16GW園區、預計2027年起逐步上線，需FIRB核准，用途偏推論而非訓練。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a capacity and sovereignty story more than a model story. The FIRB condition and local energy rules remain the binding uncertainties before any Claude traffic actually lands.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是產能與主權故事，多過模型故事。FIRB條件與在地能源規範，仍是Claude流量真正落地前的硬不確定性。
items_flat.quote: To have secured Anthropic’s first major investment in Australia is a massive show of confidence in Queensland.
items_flat.quote_zh: 爭取到Anthropic在澳洲的首筆重大投資，是對昆士蘭極大的信心展現。

items_flat.title_en: Meta introduces Meta One paid plans bundling apps and extra AI usage
items_flat.title_zh: Meta推出Meta One付費方案，捆綁應用與額外AI用量
items_flat.summary_en: Meta introduced Meta One, a subscription spanning Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp and Meta AI, with individual Plus plans plus Core and Premium-style bundles that add more usage of compute-heavy AI features. Meta said more than 50 features are in scope and that core apps and basic Meta AI remain free.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta推出橫跨Instagram、Facebook、WhatsApp與Meta AI的Meta One訂閱，含單一產品Plus以及Core、Premium等加碼運算密集型AI用量的組合。Meta稱涵蓋逾50項功能，核心應用與基本Meta AI仍免費。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is monetization of assistant and creator features rather than a new frontier model. Conversion will depend on whether paid AI quota and Business Agent capacity are scarce enough to feel worth the fee.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是助理與創作者功能變現，不是新的前沿模型。轉化取決於付費AI配額與Business Agent產能是否稀缺到讓人覺得值得付。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing Meta One, a new subscription service on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Meta AI that offers more AI usage, enhanced expression features, and tools for creators and businesses.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出Meta One，在Facebook、Instagram、WhatsApp與Meta AI提供更多AI用量、強化表達功能，以及給創作者與商家的工具。

items_flat.title_en: Meta opens WhatsApp Business Tools MCP for coding agents
items_flat.title_zh: Meta開放WhatsApp Business Tools MCP給程式代理
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced a WhatsApp Business Tools MCP server that lets agents such as Claude, Cursor, Codex or ChatGPT set up and manage WhatsApp Business Platform assets. The beta remote server can create accounts, verify numbers, manage templates and related admin work.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta宣布WhatsApp Business Tools MCP伺服器，讓Claude、Cursor、Codex或ChatGPT等代理可建立與管理WhatsApp商業平台資產。遠端測試伺服器可開戶、驗證號碼、管理範本與相關後台作業。
items_flat.analysis_en: Giving third-party agents admin-level WhatsApp setup reduces onboarding friction and concentrates operational risk in MCP auth scopes. Availability is still a gradual beta.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 讓第三方代理擁有WhatsApp後台開通權，降低導入摩擦，也把營運風險集中在MCP授權範圍。目前仍是逐步測試。
items_flat.quote: WhatsApp Business Tools MCP changes that. It's an MCP server that connects your Service Provider AI coding agent (Claude, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT) to the WhatsApp Business Platform, directly in your workflow.
items_flat.quote_zh: WhatsApp Business Tools MCP改變了這一點。它是一台MCP伺服器，讓你的AI程式代理（Claude、Cursor、Codex、ChatGPT）直接在工作流裡連接WhatsApp Business Platform。

items_flat.title_en: Mozilla and Mistral put Mistral models in Firefox Smart Window
items_flat.title_zh: Mozilla與Mistral將Mistral模型放入Firefox Smart Window
items_flat.summary_en: Mozilla and Mistral announced a partnership to power Firefox Smart Window beta with Mistral models, starting with Mistral Small 4 for users in the US and Canada and expanding Smart Window plus French-language support in France, with the UK and Germany expected later. Both said conversations are not saved on Mozilla servers by default and that Mistral agrees to zero data retention.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mozilla與Mistral宣布合作，以Mistral模型驅動Firefox Smart Window測試版，先在美加使用Mistral Small 4，並把Smart Window與法文支援擴到法國，英德預計稍後跟進。雙方稱對話預設不存在Mozilla伺服器，Mistral同意零資料留存。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a distribution win for open-weight models inside a major browser, not a new frontier checkpoint. Share of Smart Window traffic versus default Big Tech models will show whether the choice is real.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是開源權重模型打進主流瀏覽器的通路勝仗，不是新的前沿檢查點。Smart Window流量有多少真的選Mistral、而非預設大廠模型，才看得出選擇是否成立。
items_flat.quote: Firefox Smart Window (beta), Mozilla’s AI browsing assistant, is now powered by Mistral models.
items_flat.quote_zh: Mozilla的AI瀏覽助理Firefox Smart Window（測試版）現已由Mistral模型驅動。

items_flat.title_en: Grok Build v1.0.33 tightens MCP, memory and long-running agent sessions
items_flat.title_zh: Grok Build v1.0.33強化MCP、記憶與長時代理工作階段
items_flat.summary_en: Release notes circulated for Grok Build v1.0.33 describe structured JSON from MCP tools, cancelled tool calls that now notify the server to stop, in-modal memory deletion, and preservation of compaction checkpoints in long-running sessions.
items_flat.summary_zh: 流傳的Grok Build v1.0.33發行說明寫道：MCP工具改回傳結構化JSON、取消的工具呼叫會通知伺服器停止、可在視窗內刪除記憶，長時工作階段會保留壓縮檢查點。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is tooling reliability, not a Grok 4.7 model drop. It matters for people already running Grok Bot / Grok Build workflows; it does not change the public frontier-model ladder.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是工具可靠性，不是Grok 4.7模型發表。對已在跑Grok Bot／Grok Build流程的人有用，不改變公開前沿模型梯隊。

anthropic.summary_zh: Novo與Anthropic於2026年9月16日宣布，Novo將把Anthropic模型與Claude Science用於研發科學推理與代理式軟體工程。雙方表示將共同處理已盤點的發現難題，並維持人為監督與資料治理。
anthropic.analysis_en: This moves Claude from Novo’s earlier documentation use case into discovery science itself. Impact still depends on which workflows Claude Science is allowed to touch and how tightly results are validated in the lab.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這讓Claude從Novo先前的文件場景進入發現科學本身。影響仍取決於Claude Science被允許碰哪些流程，以及實驗室驗證有多嚴。
anthropic.quote: By giving leading researchers access to safe, capable, and trusted frontier models, we can shorten research timelines, improve outcomes, and discover medicines and treatments that significantly improve human life.
anthropic.quote_zh: 讓一線研究者使用安全、有能力且可信的前沿模型，我們就能縮短研究時程、改善結果，並發現能顯著改善人類生活的藥物與療法。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic signs agreement for first Australian data centre in Queensland
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic簽署澳洲首座資料中心協議，地點在昆士蘭
anthropic.summary_en: Queensland Premier David Crisafulli said Anthropic signed an agreement for its first Australian data centre at the planned Western Downs Digital Park near Dalby, part of a Zerra DC project. Reuters reported a lease covering a planned 2.16 GW campus slated to start coming online in 2027, subject to FIRB approval, and intended for inference rather than training.
anthropic.summary_zh: 昆士蘭州長Crisafulli表示，Anthropic已為位於Dalby附近Western Downs Digital Park的澳洲首座資料中心簽約，屬Zerra DC計畫。路透稱租約涵蓋規劃2.16GW園區、預計2027年起逐步上線，需FIRB核准，用途偏推論而非訓練。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is a capacity and sovereignty story more than a model story. The FIRB condition and local energy rules remain the binding uncertainties before any Claude traffic actually lands.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是產能與主權故事，多過模型故事。FIRB條件與在地能源規範，仍是Claude流量真正落地前的硬不確定性。
anthropic.quote: To have secured Anthropic’s first major investment in Australia is a massive show of confidence in Queensland.
anthropic.quote_zh: 爭取到Anthropic在澳洲的首筆重大投資，是對昆士蘭極大的信心展現。

google.title_en: Google DeepMind launches the DeepMind Institute for AGI debate
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind launched the DeepMind Institute as a platform for essays and debate on AGI’s technical and societal questions, directed by Shane Legg, James Manyika and Demis Hassabis, with Legg as managing editor. The site opened with pieces on economic policy, reasoning transparency, access and human flourishing.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind成立DeepMind Institute，作為AGI技術與社會問題的論文與辯論平台，由Shane Legg、James Manyika與Demis Hassabis主導，Legg任總編。開站文章涵蓋經濟政策、推理透明度、近用與人類繁榮。
google.analysis_en: This is a publishing and convening vehicle, not a model or safety evaluator. Its value turns on whether outside authors can disagree in public and whether the essays feed product or policy choices.
google.analysis_zh: 這是出版與召集機制，不是模型或安全評估器。價值取決於外部作者能否公開唱反調，以及文章會不會進入產品或政策選擇。
google.quote: The institute was created because broad-based intellectual discussion and debate are required to arrive at a consensus about how to address the challenges and opportunities we face as a society.
google.quote_zh: 成立該研究所，是因為要對社會面臨的挑戰與機會形成共識，需要廣泛的智識討論與辯論。

google.title_en: Google opens Home MCP so third-party agents can control Nest devices
google.title_zh: Google開放Home MCP讓第三方代理控制Nest裝置
google.summary_en: Google began early access to a Google Home MCP server so MCP-capable agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, Hermes, OpenClaw and Google Antigravity can inspect structures, read event history and control devices in the Home ecosystem, including Nest. Access is gated through Google Home Premium Advanced and a Cloud project setup.
google.summary_zh: Google開始提供Google Home MCP伺服器早期存取，讓Claude、ChatGPT、Hermes、OpenClaw與Google Antigravity等支援MCP的代理可檢視住家結構、讀事件紀錄並控制含Nest在內的Home裝置。需Google Home Premium Advanced與Cloud專案設定。
google.analysis_en: Opening locks, cameras and HVAC to arbitrary agents is a real capability jump and a concentrated security surface. The paid gate and Cloud-project setup will keep the first wave small.
google.analysis_zh: 把鎖、攝影機與空調交給任意代理，能力躍進同時也是集中資安面。付費門檻與Cloud專案設定會讓第一波規模維持很小。
google.quote: This allows any AI agents that support MCP, including Google Antigravity, Claude, Hermes or Open Claw, to securely work with all of the devices and event history in your Google Home ecosystem.
google.quote_zh: 這讓任何支援MCP的AI代理人，包括Google Antigravity、Claude、Hermes或OpenClaw，能安全地使用Google Home生態系中的裝置與事件紀錄。

meta.title_en: Meta introduces Meta One paid plans bundling apps and extra AI usage
meta.title_zh: Meta推出Meta One付費方案，捆綁應用與額外AI用量
meta.summary_en: Meta introduced Meta One, a subscription spanning Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp and Meta AI, with individual Plus plans plus Core and Premium-style bundles that add more usage of compute-heavy AI features. Meta said more than 50 features are in scope and that core apps and basic Meta AI remain free.
meta.summary_zh: Meta推出橫跨Instagram、Facebook、WhatsApp與Meta AI的Meta One訂閱，含單一產品Plus以及Core、Premium等加碼運算密集型AI用量的組合。Meta稱涵蓋逾50項功能，核心應用與基本Meta AI仍免費。
meta.analysis_en: This is monetization of assistant and creator features rather than a new frontier model. Conversion will depend on whether paid AI quota and Business Agent capacity are scarce enough to feel worth the fee.
meta.analysis_zh: 這是助理與創作者功能變現，不是新的前沿模型。轉化取決於付費AI配額與Business Agent產能是否稀缺到讓人覺得值得付。
meta.quote: We’re introducing Meta One, a new subscription service on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Meta AI that offers more AI usage, enhanced expression features, and tools for creators and businesses.
meta.quote_zh: 我們推出Meta One，在Facebook、Instagram、WhatsApp與Meta AI提供更多AI用量、強化表達功能，以及給創作者與商家的工具。

meta.title_en: Meta opens WhatsApp Business Tools MCP for coding agents
meta.title_zh: Meta開放WhatsApp Business Tools MCP給程式代理
meta.summary_en: Meta announced a WhatsApp Business Tools MCP server that lets agents such as Claude, Cursor, Codex or ChatGPT set up and manage WhatsApp Business Platform assets. The beta remote server can create accounts, verify numbers, manage templates and related admin work.
meta.summary_zh: Meta宣布WhatsApp Business Tools MCP伺服器，讓Claude、Cursor、Codex或ChatGPT等代理可建立與管理WhatsApp商業平台資產。遠端測試伺服器可開戶、驗證號碼、管理範本與相關後台作業。
meta.analysis_en: Giving third-party agents admin-level WhatsApp setup reduces onboarding friction and concentrates operational risk in MCP auth scopes. Availability is still a gradual beta.
meta.analysis_zh: 讓第三方代理擁有WhatsApp後台開通權，降低導入摩擦，也把營運風險集中在MCP授權範圍。目前仍是逐步測試。
meta.quote: WhatsApp Business Tools MCP changes that. It's an MCP server that connects your Service Provider AI coding agent (Claude, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT) to the WhatsApp Business Platform, directly in your workflow.
meta.quote_zh: WhatsApp Business Tools MCP改變了這一點。它是一台MCP伺服器，讓你的AI程式代理（Claude、Cursor、Codex、ChatGPT）直接在工作流裡連接WhatsApp Business Platform。

xai.title_en: Grok Build v1.0.33 tightens MCP, memory and long-running agent sessions
xai.title_zh: Grok Build v1.0.33強化MCP、記憶與長時代理工作階段
xai.summary_en: Release notes circulated for Grok Build v1.0.33 describe structured JSON from MCP tools, cancelled tool calls that now notify the server to stop, in-modal memory deletion, and preservation of compaction checkpoints in long-running sessions.
xai.summary_zh: 流傳的Grok Build v1.0.33發行說明寫道：MCP工具改回傳結構化JSON、取消的工具呼叫會通知伺服器停止、可在視窗內刪除記憶，長時工作階段會保留壓縮檢查點。
xai.analysis_en: This is tooling reliability, not a Grok 4.7 model drop. It matters for people already running Grok Bot / Grok Build workflows; it does not change the public frontier-model ladder.
xai.analysis_zh: 這是工具可靠性，不是Grok 4.7模型發表。對已在跑Grok Bot／Grok Build流程的人有用，不改變公開前沿模型梯隊。

frontier_other.title_en: OpenAI confirms talks with Anthropic and Google on an AI safety standards body
frontier_other.title_zh: OpenAI證實與Anthropic、Google討論AI安全標準機構
frontier_other.summary_en: OpenAI said it has been discussing industry-led AI safety coordination with Anthropic and Google DeepMind, following Demis Hassabis’s earlier idea of a FINRA-like standards body. OpenAI global policy chief Chris Lehane told reporters the talks are exploratory rather than a finished charter.
frontier_other.summary_zh: OpenAI表示已與Anthropic、Google DeepMind討論由產業主導的AI安全協調，呼應Hassabis稍早提出類似FINRA的標準機構構想。OpenAI全球政策主管Chris Lehane向媒體說明，目前仍屬探討、尚無章程。
frontier_other.analysis_en: A joint evaluator or pre-release test regime would be material if it gets binding access and publish rights. So far this is confirmed talk, not a charter, and antitrust plus smaller-lab exclusion remain open risks.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 若聯合評估或發布前測試取得具約束力的存取與公開權，才有實質意義。目前只是證實在談、不是章程，反壟斷與排除較小實驗室仍是風險。
frontier_other.quote: It’s better to try to work together to prioritize safety.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 最好試著合作，把安全放在優先位置。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA, Google and Emerald AI launch grid-flexible data-centre alliance
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA、Google與Emerald AI成立電網彈性資料中心聯盟
frontier_other.summary_en: Emerald AI, Google and NVIDIA announced the AI Energy Management Alliance to push data centres that can cut or shift power draw when the grid is stressed, arguing flexibility should speed interconnection. Eighteen launch partners include Anthropic, Analog Devices, National Grid, AES, RWE, Constellation and NRG.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Emerald AI、Google與NVIDIA宣布成立AI能源管理聯盟，推動資料中心在電網吃緊時降載或轉移用電，並主張彈性應換取更快併網。18家啟動夥伴包含Anthropic、Analog Devices、National Grid、AES、RWE、Constellation與NRG。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This is an interconnection-and-policy play, not a model release. Whether utilities treat flexibility as verifiable capacity will decide if AI campuses connect faster or the alliance stays a talking shop.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這是併網與政策布局，不是模型發布。公用事業是否把可驗證的彈性當成容量，將決定AI園區能否更快上電，或聯盟停留在倡議。
frontier_other.quote: Today, Emerald AI, Google and NVIDIA announced the launch of the AI Energy Management Alliance (AEMA), a first-of-its-kind coalition advancing data centers that can dynamically manage their electricity use in response to grid conditions.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今日Emerald AI、Google與NVIDIA宣布成立AI能源管理聯盟（AEMA），推動能依電網狀態動態管理用電的資料中心。

frontier_other.title_en: Mozilla and Mistral put Mistral models in Firefox Smart Window
frontier_other.title_zh: Mozilla與Mistral將Mistral模型放入Firefox Smart Window
frontier_other.summary_en: Mozilla and Mistral announced a partnership to power Firefox Smart Window beta with Mistral models, starting with Mistral Small 4 for users in the US and Canada and expanding Smart Window plus French-language support in France, with the UK and Germany expected later. Both said conversations are not saved on Mozilla servers by default and that Mistral agrees to zero data retention.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mozilla與Mistral宣布合作，以Mistral模型驅動Firefox Smart Window測試版，先在美加使用Mistral Small 4，並把Smart Window與法文支援擴到法國，英德預計稍後跟進。雙方稱對話預設不存在Mozilla伺服器，Mistral同意零資料留存。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This is a distribution win for open-weight models inside a major browser, not a new frontier checkpoint. Share of Smart Window traffic versus default Big Tech models will show whether the choice is real.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這是開源權重模型打進主流瀏覽器的通路勝仗，不是新的前沿檢查點。Smart Window流量有多少真的選Mistral、而非預設大廠模型，才看得出選擇是否成立。
frontier_other.quote: Firefox Smart Window (beta), Mozilla’s AI browsing assistant, is now powered by Mistral models.
frontier_other.quote_zh: Mozilla的AI瀏覽助理Firefox Smart Window（測試版）現已由Mistral模型驅動。

brief_en: OpenAI shipped ChatGPT Sponsored Agents and a public misalignment-reporting framework with six incident reports. Anthropic folded Cowork into chat and partnered with Novo on discovery science. Google opened Home MCP and a DeepMind Institute; NVIDIA, Google and Emerald launched a grid-flexibility alliance. Meta One and WhatsApp MCP, plus Mozilla–Mistral in Firefox, rounded out the day.
brief_zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT贊助代理與錯位揭露框架並公開六案；Anthropic把Cowork併入對話並與Novo合作新藥探索。Google開放Home MCP與DeepMind Institute；NVIDIA、Google與Emerald組電網彈性聯盟。Meta One、WhatsApp MCP與Mozilla–Mistral進Firefox同日登場。
